items.text: For adults having a percutaneous spinal cord stimulator trial in the regional pain service, what is the difference in health service cost per trial episode between the telephone day 3 review (2027) and the in-person day 3 visit (2026), and how do unplanned attendances, 30-day infections and on-time implant decisions compare?
items.population: Adults having a percutaneous spinal cord stimulator trial in the regional pain service, January 2026 to December 2027
items.intervention: Structured nurse telephone review on day 3 with a same-day slot for flagged problems (2027)
items.outcome: Health service cost per trial episode from lead placement to 30 days after lead removal, with unplanned attendances, infections and on-time implant decisions as consequences
items.time: Lead placement to 30 days after lead removal

items.text: What is the difference in patient and companion cost per trial episode between the two pathways?
items.population: Same patients as q1 and their companions
items.outcome: Travel, out-of-pocket and lost working time costs per episode, estimated from postcode distance

finer: Feasible from existing records with four hours a week; interesting to the service manager and to patients who travel far; novel because no patient-perspective costing exists; ethical as a service evaluation; relevant because the pathway may extend to implant follow-up.
summary: One primary cost question with consequences, one patient-perspective question.
